title: PBMCs, control 1, set 1, scRNAseq
extract_protocol_ch1: Frozen PBMCs of 3 patients and 5 controls were processed following our protocol for Sample-Multiplexed, FACS-Preprocessing of PBMCs with Rare Cell Type enrichment (https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j8nlk82m5l5r/v1). In brief, samples were thawed, washed, stained with PE anti-human CD123, APC anti-human CD303, and TotalSeq™-C antibody hashtags (BioLegend) before sample pooling. Pool 1 consisted of patients 1 and 2, and controls sc Co3, sc Co4, and sc Co5 and three more samples not relevant to this study, and pool 2 consisted of patient 3 and controls sc Co1 and sc Co2 and five more samples not relevant to this study. Pools were cleared of dead cells and enriched for pDCs using the BD FACSAria™ III Cell Sorter.  During sorting, monocytes were filtered out for pool 1, while they were retained for pool2.

33,000 live cells were loaded onto two lanes each (referred to as set1 and set2) of the Chip G of the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' v2 (Dual Index) Kit (10x Genomics). GEX libraries were constructed according to the kit instructions. Libraries were sequenced on a P3 Flow Cell on an Illumina NextSeq 1000 machine.
data_processing: Raw data processing was performed using the cellranger v7.1.0 multi pipeline (setting expect-cells = 20000 and include-introns = True).

Cells were demultiplexed using an in-house hashtag demultiplexer and genetically with CellSNP-lite (v1.2.2) and Vireo (v0.5.8). Sample-doublets were identified and subsequently removed using our hashtag demultiplexer, Vireo (v0.5.8).
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: .h5 files containing sample-demultiplexed count matrix including cell and gene IDs.

metadata.source_identity_policy: Original title, exact deposited file and explicit protocol establish eight participants with two capture lanes each. Both lanes share one conservative participant/material UID; no separate draw inferred.

metadata.source_handling_policy: Both pools enriched for plasmacytoid dendritic cells. Pool1 additionally depleted monocytes, pool2 retained them. Composition, coverage and geometry are conditional on this selection and cannot represent untreated whole PBMC.
metadata.source_demographic_policy: Individual age, sex, exact draw dates and clinical severity not independently joined; no cohort or genotype-based clinical imputation.
metadata.source_time_policy: unspecified_source_material is a conservative computational grouping token, not a source-reported visit. set1/set2 are capture lanes, not timepoints.

title: PBMCs, patient 1, set 1, scRNAseq
extract_protocol_ch1: Frozen PBMCs of 3 patients and 5 controls were processed following our protocol for Sample-Multiplexed, FACS-Preprocessing of PBMCs with Rare Cell Type enrichment (https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j8nlk82m5l5r/v1). In brief, samples were thawed, washed, stained with PE anti-human CD123, APC anti-human CD303, and TotalSeq™-C antibody hashtags (BioLegend) before sample pooling. Pool 1 consisted of patients 1 and 2, and controls sc Co3, sc Co4, and sc Co5 and three more samples not relevant to this study, and pool 2 consisted of patient 3 and controls sc Co1 and sc Co2 and five more samples not relevant to this study. Pools were cleared of dead cells and enriched for pDCs using the BD FACSAria™ III Cell Sorter.  During sorting, monocytes were filtered out for pool 1, while they were retained for pool2.

33,000 live cells were loaded onto two lanes each (referred to as set1 and set2) of the Chip G of the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' v2 (Dual Index) Kit (10x Genomics). GEX libraries were constructed according to the kit instructions. Libraries were sequenced on a P3 Flow Cell on an Illumina NextSeq 1000 machine.
data_processing: Raw data processing was performed using the cellranger v7.1.0 multi pipeline (setting expect-cells = 20000 and include-introns = True).

Cells were demultiplexed using an in-house hashtag demultiplexer and genetically with CellSNP-lite (v1.2.2) and Vireo (v0.5.8). Sample-doublets were identified and subsequently removed using our hashtag demultiplexer, Vireo (v0.5.8).
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: .h5 files containing sample-demultiplexed count matrix including cell and gene IDs.
